description: This file defines a custom Markdown renderer class 'Renderer' extending 'marked.Renderer', with methods for rendering code blocks, inline code, images, links, headings, tables, lists, and text formatting, tailored for Mattermost's markdown processing with additional features like search term highlighting and external URL handling.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: A custom markdown renderer extending 'marked.Renderer' to handle specific rendering logic for Mattermost, including code blocks, images, links, headings, tables, lists, and inline text with search highlighting and URL safety features.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Renders code blocks, with special handling for LaTeX and search term highlighting.

methods.name: codespan
methods.description: Renders inline code spans with optional search term highlighting.

methods.name: br
methods.description: Overrides line break rendering, returning space if singleline option is set.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Renders images with optional dimensions and proxy handling.

methods.name: heading
methods.description: Renders headings with appropriate level and class.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Renders links with URL safety, external request checks, and search pattern highlighting.

methods.name: paragraph
methods.description: Renders paragraphs, using span instead of p for inline images if singleline is set.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Renders a responsive table with header and body.

methods.name: tablecell
methods.description: Renders a table cell, extending marked's default.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Renders ordered or unordered lists with optional start index.

methods.name: listitem
methods.description: Renders list items, including task list checkboxes.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Renders inline text with formatting and emoji processing.
